\caption{\textbf{The audited contrast moves with the query: $\Gamma_{\mathrm{spec}}$ is positive in every placebo-controlled model and zero in SFT.} All values use the mask operator and are in nats per token; Appendix~\ref{app:qspec} defines them. The partner contrast scores the question's own interval and is the likelihood drop when its event's frames are masked minus the drop when the partner event's frames are masked. The left block gives the trained-minus-base change of this contrast under the question's own query ($\Delta\psi_{\mathrm{own}}$) and under the partner event's query ($\Delta\psi_{\mathrm{cross}}$), and $\Gamma_{\mathrm{spec}}=\Delta\psi_{\mathrm{own}}-\Delta\psi_{\mathrm{cross}}$ with the fraction of questions on which it is positive.
